name: Takamiya Maho
source:
An arrogant, ill-natured upper-class wife who also works as the secretary to her husband, the president of the major trading company AINS. A materialistic upstart who looks down on commoners and believes money and power are everything. Used to be a gyaru in her youth.

[From [url=https://ubai.org/ubai/jouryutuma/index.html#character]official site[/url]]
